name: verticalbar-agent
description: Vertical Bar Agent: local stdio MCP tools and skills for grounded CrossCheck and Vertical Bar work. Identity comes from explicit Cognito login and workspace scope from authorized discovery; deployment effects remain behind CrossCheck's server-side scopes and Pipeline stage approval.

interface.shortDescription: Local CrossCheck and Vertical Bar workflows with the Vertical Bar Agent desktop companion.
interface.longDescription: Use the same Vertical Bar Agent skills through a local stdio bridge. The separately installed desktop companion adds interactive sign-in and NetSuite onboarding that a hosted plugin cannot install.
defaultPrompt: List the CrossCheck workspaces I can access.
Create a grounded Briefing from my latest snapshot.
Review the deployment status for my workspace.
